notes: Both italicized *the God* phrases are `added` under rule 103: θεός is spent on the subject *God*, and the article governs that expressed noun, so its phrase is complete and the repeat stands in a slot no token governs — GAL.3.20's frame. Reading either as a discontinuous second realization under rule 15 remains defensible.
The second clause expresses no subject, so rule 68 puts the supplied *is he* on the predicate ἐθνῶν.
οὐχί carries content of its own and is aligned to *not* in the ordinary way (rule 64).
